newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen flat, focus on Indocement.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen flat, focus on Indocement.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen flat on Wednesday, with the market focus seen on cement giant Indocement due to a proposed share sale and to-be listed finance firm Maharani.

"The market focus is likely to be on Indocement as it plans to sell its stake in Indofood and on Maharani which should attract much attention as it is controlled by Titik Prabowo," one broker with a foreign brokerage firm said.
Siti Hediati Prabowo (Titik Prabowo) is one of President Suharto's daughters.
Cement giant PT Indocement Tunggal Prakarsa said on Tuesday it proposed a spinoff and sale of its 50.1 percent shareholding in PT Indofood Sukses Makmur.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index ended down 0.29 points, or 0.04 percent, at 722.21 points.
